BONC STUDIOS · DRAMA SHOW AI

Privacy Policy

Effective: November 6, 2026 · Last updated: November 6, 2026

BONC Studios (“BONC”, “we”, “our”) operates the Drama Show AI / BONC Stories website at dramashow.gezimveliu.com and is developing related mobile experiences. This notice describes our current website and waitlist practices. Features that are not yet released may require a revised notice.

1. Information we collect

When you sign up, sign in, reset your password or join the pilot waitlist, you provide an email address and, where applicable, a password and verification information. Authentication is handled through our service provider, Supabase. We do not display your password to other website visitors.

If you join the waitlist, we record the email address, your waitlist status and the version of the consent you accepted. If you contact support, we receive the information in your message. Hosting, security and authentication providers may process technical data, such as IP addresses, request timestamps, device/browser information and security logs, to operate and protect the service.

2. How we use information

We use information to establish and secure accounts, verify email addresses, process waitlist requests, send the pilot and episode updates you opt into, respond to requests, troubleshoot issues, and prevent misuse. We do not sell email addresses. BONC currently does not enable a first-party analytics collection endpoint in the public website code; this may change, and this notice will be updated before additional analytics collection is enabled.

3. Legal bases and choices

Where applicable privacy laws require a legal basis, we rely on your consent for optional update emails, the steps necessary to provide the account services you request, and our legitimate interests in website security and reliability. You can decline optional emails and unsubscribe from promotional communications. Authentication and important security-related messages may still be needed for your account.

4. Service providers and transfers

Our website is delivered using Netlify, and authentication and waitlist operations use Supabase. Email-delivery providers may deliver verification and opted-in updates. These providers process information to deliver their services and may store or process information in countries outside your location. We do not publish a complete list of hosting regions because their configuration may change.

5. Cookies and browser storage

Account functionality may use browser storage or cookies needed to maintain your sign-in session. Providers may use essential security-related technologies. We do not presently represent that all tracking technologies are disabled across third-party infrastructure. Optional analytics or advertising technologies will be described before they are introduced.

6. Retention and protection

We keep account and waitlist information while it is needed for account operation, requested updates, security, applicable recordkeeping or legal obligations. Backup and service-provider retention may outlast account deletion requests for limited periods. We apply reasonable technical and organizational security measures, but no online service can guarantee absolute security.

7. Your rights

Depending on your location, you may be entitled to request access, correction, export or deletion of personal data, or to object to or restrict processing. You may withdraw marketing consent at any time. To make a request or ask about retention, contact support@gezimveliu.com. We may need to verify that a request relates to your account before acting on it.

8. Children

The website is not designed for children under 13 and we do not knowingly solicit their personal information. If a parent or guardian believes a child provided personal information, please contact us so we can review and address it. Additional age restrictions may apply to mobile services as they launch.

9. Updates and contact

We may update this policy as our services and applicable requirements change. Material changes will be communicated where required. For privacy inquiries: support@gezimveliu.com.

This policy describes the current BONC website and waitlist; it does not claim that unreleased video streaming, advertising or in-app purchases are already available.
